description: The rule of snapping (contracts/README.md, section 12): from the strokes of a submission, their groups and the numbers of its crops to the strokes that a box of a model, in whole thousandths of a crop at one height, takes, and the box of their points in tenths, or null when it takes none. canvas's vectors/snaps.json at its tag v0.1.2.

cases.name: staircase
cases.description: The example of canvas's research into a child's writing and the AI tutor: a ladder of two posts and seven rungs, «30» beside it after a pause, «180 : 30 = 5» after another, the 5 erased, then 6, ringed.

cases.name: later
cases.description: «12 + 5 =», and 8 s later «17» right after it: what is written later next to old writing is a group of its own (R06 canvas).

cases.name: lines
cases.description: Two lines a cell apart, the second begun 1.5 s after the first, with no pause to think: a group each.

cases.name: signs
cases.description: 3/4 + 1/4 = 1 in fractions over bars, underlined; 3 s later «12 : 4 = 3» below: a group each, with their bars, dots and lines.

cases.name: words
cases.description: Two lines of joined-up words, each word a stroke, with the dot of an i put after its word: a group a line.

cases.name: tutor
cases.description: Two lines as tutor's synthetic writer draws them: digits 36 high, 26 apart, lines 80 apart, 1.5 s before a line and 120 to 249 ms between strokes.

cases.name: crossed
cases.description: A line crossed out at once, 0.4 s after it, which is of its group; another crossed out 3 s after it, which is a group of its own.

cases.name: bridge
cases.description: «12» and «34» far apart, a line under both 0.3 s on, which joins them; «56» and «78» the same, the line 4 s on, which joins neither.

cases.name: undone
cases.description: «12» erased and brought back by undo 3 s on, «3» written next to it 0.5 s after that, the sheet cleared and that undone: «12» keeps the time it was written, a group apart from «3».

cases.name: bounds
cases.description: Pairs at the rule's bounds and just past them: 2000 and 2001 ms, 50 and 50.1 units across, 50 and 50.1 down.

cases.name: rounding
cases.description: Dots in hundredths of a unit and fractions of a millisecond, in pairs. The rule rounds half up: 100.05 units are 1001 tenths, so the first pair is 500 tenths apart across, the fourth 2000 ms apart and the sixth 500 tenths apart down — neighbours all three, which rounding half to even or cutting the fraction off would part. The second pair, 50.02 units apart, is 501 tenths, and the third and fifth come out at the bounds from just above.

cases.name: whole
cases.description: Digits at the top left corner, in the middle and at the bottom right corner: the work is the whole sheet. Its crop fits Claude's standard tier at 32 px, and at 48 px it would not, so its digits come out 32 px.

cases.name: answer
cases.description: A one-digit answer, under the least size of a crop: the crop is 200 px each way, and its margins widen to keep the digit in the middle.

cases.name: limit
cases.description: Three dots that span 660 by 1362 units: no bundle, so the median is 15. At 17 px the crop is 772 by 1568 px, 28 by 56 tiles of 28 px, 1568 tokens: at both of Claude's limits at once. From 18 px up it is drawn at 17.
